## About
Capitol Wholesale Nursery is a grower, plant broker and re-wholesaler in San Jose, right off Capitol Expressway. Landscapers and designers come to us so they don't have to call around town looking for plants. We're open to the public too, so homeowners are welcome to come browse.
Our inventory keeps rotating: ornamentals, bamboo, ferns, fruit trees, grass and turf grass, ground cover, sod products and dry goods. If you don't see a plant on our lists, ask. We work with a network of growers and nurseries in the Bay Area and beyond to track it down.
We're rated 4.3 on Google from 117 reviews. Give us a call, send a text, or stop by the nursery on Everdale Drive.

## Services
- Grower: We grow and nurture some of the plants we sell right here at our San Jose nursery.
- Plant Broker: Need a specific plant for a client, on a big job or a small one? We'll reach out to our network of growers and nurseries to get it for you.
- Re-Wholesaler: Come to one source instead of calling around. Our team handles the searching so landscapers can get back to work.
- Retail: We're open to the public, so anyone can come in and shop during business hours.
- Prompt delivery service: We deliver plants when and where you need them, on your schedule.
- Expert consultation: Ask us about our inventory, your project, plant availability and growing conditions.
- Access to hard-to-find plants: If it's not on our lists, we'll go looking for it through our grower and supplier partners.
- Root barriers, tree stakes and ties: The supplies that go in the ground with your trees.

## FAQ
Q: Are you open to the public?
A: Yes. We're open Monday through Friday 7:30AM to 4:30PM, and Saturday 8:30AM to 4PM. Closed Sunday.

Q: How does picking up plants work?
A: One reviewer explained it well: grab one of our wagons and pull the plants yourself, or hand us a list and we'll pull them for you.

Q: Can I get a quote?
A: Yes, quotes are free. Our estimators include botanical names, current and future availability and specifications, and possible substitutions.

Q: What if I bought too much?
A: Returns can be handled by pick-up or brought back to the nursery. Check our return policy for the details.

## What customers say
- "I spent some time at the nursery and loved it! There were so many plants of different sizes and varieties, and plants I didn't know existed.   Many of them I've seen used for landscaping in the community.  Robert & the team are an encyclopedia of information on everything in that nursery.  The people here are the kindness, most down-to-earth souls you'll ever meet.  One of the first and most interesting things I learned was that as a wholesaler, their goal isn't to provide the kind of customer service you'd expect to get at Home Depot.  The employees do their best to point customers in the right direction, but their focus is to keep the plants thriving, receiving new plants, and preparing large orders, among many other things needed to keep a nursery running.  Show up knowing what you're looking for or be OK to explore on your own, and when you have a question someone will be happy to help you out." (Ngoc Hoang, 5/5)
- "Great selection of plants, including lots of natives, and cheaper than other nurseries. You either have to pick up the plants yourself using one of their wagons, or give them a list and they'll do it for you." (Michael Tran, 5/5)
